steps: Rinse the rice and add it to the cooker with 2 cups of water.
Stir in garlic and onion, then cook until the rice is soft and porridge-like.
Top with a boiled egg and season with soy sauce if available.
Beat the eggs and stir in chopped tomato and onion.
Cook gently in a lightly oiled pan until set, or microwave in a covered microwave-safe bowl in short intervals.
Rest briefly, then serve with rice if you have it.
Add cooked rice, garlic, and a little oil to the rice cooker.
Stir once, close the lid, and heat until steaming. Stir again halfway through.
Serve with a cooked egg if available.
